seatedToss.guidance: Khalani pansi patebulo ndipo muzitsatizana kuponya thumba lofewa la nyemba mu chandamale chachikulu. Sungani zowerengera pamapepala, pamodzi.
steps: Sindikizani chandamale ndi pepala lowerengera, ndipo muliike pansi patebulo pakati panu.
Khalani momasuka, mmodzi mbali iliyonse. Tsatanani ponyani modekha kamodzi kalikonse, kapena pitirizani ngati simukufuna.
Ponyo likagwera mkati mwa mphete, munthu amene wataya aikepo tiki m'bokosi limodzi la mzere wake, pamzere wa mphete imeneyo.
Yang'anani matiki pamodzi mukamaliza, ngati mukufuna. Palibe amene ayenera kuwerengera chilichonse.
Lekani nthawi iliyonse pamene wina wakonzeka.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Gwiritsani ntchito thumba lokhala ndi chivundikiro chosokedwa kapena sokosi yopukutidwa lokha, khalani pansi, musaponye kumaso, ndipo khalani ndi wamkulu pafupi. Zinthu zing'onozing'ono zingayambitse kutsamwa.
safety: Sankhani thumba la nyemba lokhala ndi chivundikiro chosokedwa, kapena pukutani sokosi yoyera. Choyamba liyang'aneni ngati lili ndi mabowo kapena zosoka zotayirira, kuti palibe chodzaza chingatuluke.
Nyemba, mpunga ndi zina zodzaza zing'onozing'ono zingayambitse kutsamwa. Zisungeni kutali ndi ana aang'ono komanso kwa aliyense amene amaika zinthu m'kamwa.
Khalani pafupi kuti mutha kufikira, ndipo muziyang'anira mosamala ngati pangakhale chinthu chomwe chingaikidwe m'kamwa.
Khalani pansi. Ponyani modekha komanso pansi pang'ono kulunjika ku chandamale patebulo, osati kumaso konse.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Pepala losindikizidwa: chandamale cha mphete zitatu zotchedwa Pafupi, Pakati ndi Patali, kuyambira kunja kulowa mkati, ndi pepala lowerengera lokhala ndi mzere wa munthu aliyense ndi mizere ya mabokosi opanda kanthu a mphete iliyonse.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Ikani pepalalo pansi pakati panu. Ponyo likagwera mkati mwa mphete, ikani tiki m'bokosi la mzere wanu, pamzere wa mphete imeneyo.

conversationCards.guidance: Werengani kadi mokweza. Palibe mayankho olondola.
conversationCards.groupSit: Khalani mozungulira pomwe aliyense akhoza kuona chithunzicho. Munthu wogwira khadi, kapena chipangizo chokhala ndi chithunzi chachikulu, awerenge mutuwo mokweza poyamba.
conversationCards.groupPass: Kenako perekani khadi kwa munthu wotsatira. Aliyense anene mawu kapena chiganizo chimodzi chokhudza chithunzicho, kenako apereke.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Kupereka khadi nthawi zonse nkololedwa. Munthu akhoza kupereka popanda kunena kanthu, ndipo palibe amene ayenera kufotokoza chifukwa chake.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Gawo limatha khadiyo ikazungulira bwalo lonse, kapena gulu likakhuta. Palibe amene wapambana. Lekani nthawi iliyonse gulu likafuna.

photoPairs.guidance: Dinani chithunzi, kenako dinani chimene chikufanana nacho.
photoPairs.intro: **Sankhani zithunzi 2 mpaka 6** kuchokera pa chipangizo ichi. Zimaonekera patsamba ili lokha ndipo sizikwezedwa kapena kusungidwa.
photoPairs.empty: Zithunzi zanu zidzaoneka apa, chilichonse kawiri.

pictureBingo.guidance: Sindikizani makadi poyamba. Kenako onetsani wowerengayo pa sikirini yayikulu kwambiri imene muli nayo.
pictureBingo.start: Dinani "Chithunzi chotsatira" kuti muyitane chithunzi choyamba.

calmBreathing.guidance: Kokani mpweya pamene bwalo likukula, ndipo tulutsani pamene likucheperachepera. Lidzayima lokha pambuyo pa mpweya sikisi.
calmBreathing.started: Mwayamba. Kokani mpweya pamene bwalo likukula.
calmBreathing.finished: Imeneyo inali mpweya sikisi wodekha. Yambani kachiwiri nthawi iliyonse mukafuna.

storyChain.guidance: Lankhulani motsatizana: sentensi imodzi aliyense, ndipo onjezani chithunzi chotsatira.
storyChain.passNote: Lankhulani sentensi yanu mokweza. Palibe chimene chilembedwa kapena kusungidwa. Aliyense akhoza kudutsa.
storyChain.full: Unyolo uli ndi zithunzi zonse eyiti. Nenani nkhani yonse, kapena yambani unyolo watsopano.
